incident-bot: INCIDENT: High memory paging detected on runtime-prod-3 at 09:12 UTC. PagerDuty INC-1445 triggered. Root TS 3765432100
Alice (oncall): Taking this. I'm seeing tail latency spike and 502s around 09:10–09:15.
Bob (eng-runtime): Joining. Which node(s) exactly? I'll grab nvml and kvcache stats.
Carla (eng-sre): Can we get customer impact numbers? Any 5xx spike counts?
Dave (support): Customer-X reporting 502s since ~09:12, support is on a call.
Erin (cust-success): Opening a holding message to the customer now; will update with ETA.
Bob (eng-runtime): Running quick logs and traces:
```
kubectl -n runtime-prod logs runtime-prod-3 -c runtime --since=20m | grep -E "OOM|kvcache|page_out" | tail -n 150
```
Found repeated lines: "OOM when allocating tensor", "kvcache: page_out 4096KB", "pagewalk latency=120ms"
Bob (eng-runtime): paste log snippet:
```
[09:11:58] runtime: Alloc failed: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[09:12:02] kvcache: page_out key=conv-xyz size=3.8MB
[09:12:05] runtime: OOM fallback triggered, evicting kv pages
[09:12:07] routing: 502 upstream: runtime-prod-3
```
Carla (eng-sre): NVML snapshot shows GPU memory at 98% on GPU0, paging throughput ~72 MB/s. kvcache swapped ~8GB in the last 6m.
Frank (eng-ml): Hypothesis: rollout of /chat-stream v2 increased long-context sessions -> kv cache growth + larger per-request allocations. Also check if quantization profile changed in the last model push.
Hannah (product): We did roll out /chat-stream v2 at 09:00 in canary -> gradual. Could correlate.
Bob (eng-runtime): Suggest immediate mitigation: reduce max_batch on runtime-prod-3 from 16 -> 8 and enable aggressive kv eviction TTL. Can do hot-config change.
Alice (oncall): Applying hotfix: setting max_batch=8 on runtime-prod-3 now.
Bob (eng-runtime): Command I'm running:
```
curl -s -X POST https://infra-api.internal/runtime/prod/3/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"max_batch":8}'
```
Alice (oncall): Config apply success. Restart not needed.
incident-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: max_batch=8 applied to runtime-prod-3 at 09:23 UTC.
Bob (eng-runtime): Also flipping kvcache eviction mode to aggressive LRU and setting ttl=5m for chat keys:
```
redis-cli -h kvcache-prod-1 CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy volatile-lru
# set default ttl for prefix chat:* to 300s via kvcache service
```
Carla (eng-sre): After config changes: paging throughput dropped to ~6 MB/s, GPU mem now 85% on GPU0. 502 rate decreased to baseline.
Dave (support): Customer impact summary: ~1.2k failed requests during the spike window. Sent holding msg; will provide incident follow-up.
Erin (cust-success): Customer asks for an RCA and ETA on permanent fix. I'm scheduling a postmortem call.
Frank (eng-ml): Tracking hypotheses to validate in RCA thread:
- H1: KV cache TTL/eviction too permissive for new long-context traffic -> cache growth -> paging.
- H2: v2 chat route increased average batch/seq length -> per-request memory > expected.
- H3: Recent model/quant change increased peak allocation per token.
Bob (eng-runtime): Quick telemetry snapshot from runtime-prod-3 pre/post:
```
PRE: GPU0 24.0GiB/24.0GiB (100%)
kvcache: pages=1.2M swapped=8.3GB evict_rate=0.02/s
POST: GPU0 20.4GiB/24.0GiB (85%)
kvcache: pages=450k swapped=1.1GB evict_rate=0.8/s
```
Carla (eng-sre): I'm capturing timeline and log bundles to /incidents/3765432100/logs (s3://redwood-incidents/3765432100/). Please upload any extra traces.
Alice (oncall): I'll monitor for 2 hours. If we see >80% GPU mem for >5m again, I'll escalate.
Bob (eng-runtime): Follow-ups assigned:
- Bob: implement default TTL for chat keys + backfill eviction metrics alert.
- Frank: verify model memory regression and quantify per-token allocation change.
- Carla: run canary with reduced batch for the v2 route and validate kvcache TTL behavior.
- Hannah/Product: pause v2 rollout if canary shows regression.
Erin (cust-success): Noted. We'll include customer-facing timeline and next steps in the RCA.
Carla (eng-sre): Quick note: add a low-latency alert for kvcache swap rate > 20MB/s to catch this earlier.
Bob (eng-runtime): Adding a short-term mitigator: enforce per-request max_seq=2048 and cap batch to 8 for all v2 routes in ingress gateway.
Hannah (product): :thumbsup: pause going wider until we have the RCA.
incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: paging reduced and 5xx spike resolved at 09:58 UTC. Final event TS 3765432389. RCA thread and action items required.
Alice (oncall): Thanks team. Prep short incident note for ops channel and schedule RCA meeting.
